sara: quick follow-up from the architecture sync: proposing a 'slot-window' admission model for dedicated GPU pools to reduce churn from tiny bursts.
ajay: high-level? how is this different from credits/headroom?
sara: instead of long-lived credit balances we grant short-lived windows (eg 20-40s) that reserve a few concurrent slots. windows auto-expire, so no stale credits. sustained demand promotes to a soft lease.
leo: ok. does promotion cause the same prewarm churn we want to avoid?
sara: promotion uses hysteresis (e.g., 4 windows in 90s) and rate-limited promotions per-tenant. also prewarm coalescing groups near-simultaneous windows to one prewarm.
jenna: sample config please
sara: admission config sketch:
```
window_size=30s
slots_per_window=2
coalesce_ms=250
promote_if=4_in_90s
best_effort_prob=0.5
```
ajay: admission order? fairness vs priority?
sara: order: SLA > realtime > cost band. for best-effort we use probabilistic thinning to avoid thundering when global headroom low.
leo: cross-shard case? traffic could land on any shard.
sara: windows are local to a shard but we maintain a compact global index (monotonic counters per-tenant) so promotions/quotas approximate globally. strict enforcement happens locally to avoid oversubscribe.
jenna: billing and chargeback?
sara: bill by window-seconds (window_size * slots_used). for a promoted lease we reconcile actual runtime usage to avoid overcharging.
ajay: SLO considerations?
sara: sims show median latency improved for bursty workloads. p99 can regress if coalescing delays admission too much; it's a knob. need dashboards for windows_in_flight, promotions/sec, coalesced_prewarms, thinning_rejects.
autoscaler-bot: alert: prewarm rate +22% in last 15m on test shard; suggest increase coalesce_ms to 400ms for that shard.
leo: test plan?
sara: shadow-run in prod: mark canary tenants, run synthetic bursts, compare cold starts, cost/slot, p99. run 48h.
jenna: operator controls and rollback?
sara: operator knobs: reduce window_size, decrease slots_per_window, disable promotions, enable strict serial admission. rollback: revert config and let windows drain (<= window_size).
ajay: please add a section in RFC about SDK retry guidance: tenant-keyed exponential backoff and honor Retry-After header.
sara: will do. i'll draft RFC tonight and ping reviewers. thanks for the quick feedback! :tada:
